newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads three Africans for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads three Africans for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday publicly beheaded three Africans for smuggling drugs into the kingdom, the Interior Ministry said.
The execution in the Red Sea city of Jeddah raised to 72 the number of convicted criminals beheaded in the conservative Islamic kingdon so far this year. A total of 68 were beheaded in 1996.
A ministry statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said the three were from Chad "and the neck of each one of them was hit by the sword until they died".
The three were identified as Adam Moussa Adam, Saleh Mohammad Baker and Donqus Myodo.
Saudi Arabia applies Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug traffickers and other criminals.
